text.tagline: A little trust. A lot of suspicion.
text.title:
Trust is a
dangerous game.
text.intro: Gather your people, find your table, and let the story unfold. Your phone keeps the secrets. You play the game.
text.hostText: Be the Game Master. Create a private lobby, choose the roles, and guide the game.
text.joinText: Have an invite? Enter the six-character code from your Game Master.
text.name: Your name
text.codeHelp: Six letters or numbers. No account needed.
text.accessibleText: Built for phones, keyboards, and screen readers. Secrets are shared only when you choose.
text.liveText: Private roles. Live night choices. Less looking at screens, more reading the room.
text.historyText: Keep your match history, role history, and the shots that actually landed.
text.footer: Made for the people around your table.
text.privacy: Use headphones for private role and night announcements. A screen reader can speak secrets aloud.
text.invite: Share this code with your players
text.copyError: Could not copy. Select and copy the code above.
text.noPlayers: The first seat is still open. Share the code to invite your players.
text.waiting: Your seat is saved. The Game Master will start when everyone is ready.
text.setupHelp: Use 4–30 players. Assign one role per player. Special roles are limited to one each.
text.saveFirst: Save your role counts before starting.
text.startHelp: The Game Master is a moderator and does not take a player seat.
text.roleReady: Your role is ready. Reveal it privately.
text.gmPrivate: Private GM dashboard. Do not share this screen with players.
text.dayText: Listen closely. Make your case. Decide who you trust.
text.nightText: The town is asleep. Wait for your private prompt.
text.deadText: You are out of play. You can still follow the game.
text.soundUnavailable: Audio could not start. Screen-reader and visual alerts are still available.
text.wakeHelp: Choose who may act. Resolve pending choices before waking another role.
text.sleeping: Waiting for the Game Master to wake a role.
text.submitted: Choice sent to the Game Master.
text.teammatesHelp: Visible only to living Mafia members while Mafia is awake.
text.adjudicate: Results do not change players automatically. Apply eliminations or revivals below. Agree on role rules before play.
text.finishHelp: Finishing reveals this match's roles and action history to all participants. This cannot be undone.
text.reportsIntro: The roles you played. The chances you took. The games worth remembering.
text.profileNote: Your history is private to you and the people in each match. Create an account to keep it across devices.
text.noHistory: A fresh start. Finished games will appear here.
text.noRoles: Play a match to begin your role history.
text.reportNote: Only match participants can view a report. Hosting and cancelled matches do not count as games played.
text.heroNote: A social deduction game. A shared table. A secret for everyone.
text.castIntro: Three sides of the same story. Which one will you tell?
text.libraryHelp: Thirteen characters. Thirteen ways to change the night. Tap a card to read its role, then flip it back. These illustrations appear only here, never on your private game card.
text.mafiaMotto: Keep your friends close. Your alibi closer.
text.citizenMotto: Find the truth before the lights go out.
text.thirdMotto: Some people play by their own rules.
text.playerIdentityHelp: Names are unique at this table. Labels show who is playing as a guest or using an account.
text.keepStoryText: Save your guest profile to bring your games, roles, and victories to every device.
text.joinPrivacy: By joining, you understand that roles, votes, and actions are revealed to match participants when the game ends.
text.accountIntro: One profile. Every game. Wherever you play.
text.emailRequired: Accounts on this site need a verified email for password recovery. Playing as a guest never needs an email.
text.verificationHelp: Enter the six-digit code here. It expires in 15 minutes. You can request another code after one minute.
text.verificationSent: Verification email requested. Check your inbox and spam folder.
text.emailVerified: Email verified. Your account is ready.
text.emailPrivacy: Your email is used only for verification and account recovery. It is never shown to other players. These emails are delivered by Resend.
text.backupCodeHelp: Optional: keep a code in case you lose access to your email. Creating one replaces any old code and signs other devices out.
text.emailRecoveryIntro: Enter your verified email address. We will send a private link to choose a new password.
text.resetRequested: If an account uses this verified email, you will receive a reset link. Check your inbox and spam folder. If it does not arrive, try again later or use your backup code.
text.resetPasswordHelp: This private link works once. Your other devices will be signed out after you save a new password.
text.emailResetComplete: Your password has been reset. All previous sessions and recovery codes are now invalid. Sign in with your new password.
text.usernameHelp: 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. This is your sign-in name.
text.passwordHelp: Use at least 15 characters. A long, unique passphrase is best.
text.adoptGuest: Move this guest profile's games into my account
text.adoptGuestHelp: Without this option, you will leave the guest history behind. Finish or leave active guest games first.
text.recoveryIntro: Use the code you saved when creating your account. No email address is needed.
text.recoveryWarning: This code can reset your password. It is shown only now. Save it in a password manager or download it and keep it private.
text.savedRecovery: I have saved my recovery code
text.recovered: Password reset. Save the new recovery code, then sign in. All old sessions and the old code are now invalid.
text.recoverySaved: Account ready. Keep the recovery code safe.
text.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
text.replaceRecoveryHelp: The old recovery code will stop working and other devices will be signed out.
text.exportHelp: Download your profile and game history as a JSON file. Keep the file private.
text.deleteHelp: Your account, sessions, and player names will be removed. Shared match facts remain anonymous for other players. First leave your active games or cancel tables you host. This cannot be undone.
text.profileDeleted: Your old profile was deleted. You now have a new guest profile.
text.privacyNote: No tracking. Passwords and recovery codes are stored as hashes.
text.signedOut: Signed out. You are now using a fresh guest profile.
text.rulesTitle:
Know the rules.
Read the room.
text.rulesIntro: Mafia Table rules, version 1. A complete house ruleset inspired by social Mafia traditions—not an official tournament scenario.
text.rulesAccepted: I have reviewed these rules with the table
text.votingModeHelp: A final elimination always needs more than half of living players' votes. A tie or no majority eliminates no one.
text.introMafia: Meet your Mafia teammates. There is no attack on introduction night. Confirm when you are ready.
text.skipMissingHelp: Missing night responses become passes. Missing votes become abstentions. Use this only after checking with the players.
text.nightGuide: Collect choices in order. The app resolves every ability together at dawn. Do not announce private results aloud.
text.automaticRules: The app handles abilities, eliminations, and win conditions.
text.voteSaved: Your vote is saved. You can change it until voting closes.
text.votePrivacy: Targets stay private until this ballot closes. Final reports include each player's vote.
text.defenseHelp: Let the nominees speak, then open the final ballot.
text.votingDone: Today's vote is complete. The town is ready for night.
text.dayGunHelp: It may contain a real or blank round. You get one daytime shot. This cannot be undone.
text.useSense: Use Sixth Sense instead of the Mafia shot
text.senseHelp: Once per game. A correct guess bypasses every defense. A wrong guess wastes the shot.
text.alignmentHelp: You win with this side, even if eliminated. If all three counted players are Mafia, you must choose Mafia.
text.leaveHelp: Leaving an active match forfeits your seat and any win. You can rejoin only while the game is still in the lobby.
text.abandonHelp: This ends the table for everyone. No wins or losses will count. Match details remain visible to participants.
text.lastMoveHelp: The voted-out Terrorist may take one living player out of the game. The app checks victory after this choice.
text.cancelledNoStats: This match was cancelled and does not affect player statistics.
text.storageUnavailable: Browser preferences could not be saved. Your game is still saved on the server.
text.unexpectedError: This screen could not be displayed. Reload to restore your saved game.
text.sessionExpired: Your session changed or expired. Reload and sign in again to restore access.

prompt.mafia: Mafia, choose your proposed elimination target. Each member sends a private choice to the GM.
prompt.saul: Recruit one living player. Only a Simple Citizen can join Mafia. This one-use attempt replaces tonight's Mafia attack, even if it fails.
prompt.matador: Choose a player whose action you want to block.
prompt.doctor: Protect a living player from ordinary night shots. You can heal yourself once and cannot heal the same player on consecutive nights.
prompt.detective: Investigate a living player. Your private inbox receives their apparent faction at dawn. Godfather appears Citizen.
prompt.sniper: Use one of your two shots. Shooting a Citizen kills you instead. Protections may stop an otherwise valid shot.
prompt.gunman: Give a living player a real or blank gun for daytime use. The recipient will not know which kind it is.
prompt.constantine: Choose an eliminated player to bring back.
prompt.zodiac: Strike one living player. Your attack bypasses healing, vests, and bullet immunity.
prompt.nostradamus: Select exactly three other players. Learn how many appear to be Mafia, then choose your secret winning side.

roleDescription.godfather: Mafia leader. Your target takes priority over other Mafia choices. You appear Citizen to Detective and have one bullet-stopping vest. Once per game, guess a target's exact role instead of shooting; a correct guess bypasses every defense and prevents revival.
roleDescription.saul: After an original Mafia member is eliminated, attempt one recruitment. A Simple Citizen becomes Simple Mafia. Any other role resists. The attempt is used up either way and replaces that night's Mafia attack. A blocked attempt does not consume it.
roleDescription.matador: Block one non-Mafia player's night abilities. You cannot choose the same player on consecutive nights. Blocks are resolved first.
roleDescription.terrorist: If eliminated by the day vote, take one living player with you or pass. This last move ignores defenses. Neither you nor its victim can be revived. Night deaths and gunshots do not trigger the ability.
roleDescription.mafia: Meet your team during the Mafia wake window and propose a target. The Godfather's non-empty choice takes priority. Otherwise, a unique highest-vote target is attacked. A tie means no attack.
roleDescription.doctor: Protect one living player from ordinary night bullets. You may protect yourself once. Never choose the same target on consecutive nights. Healing cannot stop Sixth Sense, Zodiac, Terrorist, or the Sniper's friendly-fire penalty.
roleDescription.detective: Learn one player's apparent faction at dawn. Godfather appears Citizen. Third Party roles appear Third Party. Results remain in your private inbox.
roleDescription.sniper: Two night shots and one bullet-stopping vest. A shot at a Citizen, including Citizen-aligned Nostradamus, kills you instead. Other targets can be protected. A blocked shot does not spend ammunition.
roleDescription.gunman: Give out two loaded guns in total and any number of blanks, at most one gun per night. A living player can hold only one gun. The recipient cannot see its ammunition and can fire it once during day discussion.
roleDescription.constantine: Once per game, revive a previously eliminated player at dawn. You cannot revive withdrawn players or victims sealed by Sixth Sense or Terrorist. Used abilities and ammunition are not restored.
roleDescription.citizen: No night ability. Listen, discuss, and vote. A loaded gun from Gunman gives you one daytime shot.
roleDescription.zodiac: An independent killer with one bullet-stopping vest. Strike once per night, bypassing all defenses. Win when alive among the final two players. Other factions cannot win while Zodiac remains alive.
roleDescription.nostradamus: On introduction night, inspect three players; Godfather does not count as Mafia. Then secretly choose Mafia or Citizen. Three apparent Mafia forces a Mafia choice. You win with that side even if eliminated. Ordinary bullets cannot kill you, but votes, Zodiac, Terrorist, and Sixth Sense can.

rulebook.flowTitle: A night, a day, a story.
rulebook.flow: The GM hosts without a player role. Assign one role per player. Introduction night lets Mafia meet and Nostradamus choose a side; nobody attacks. Day one follows. Each later day has discussion and a vote, followed by a night of private actions.
rulebook.voting: Choose one-round or two-round voting in the lobby. In two-round play, the most-nominated player or tied players defend themselves before a final vote. A final elimination needs more than half of all living players' votes. Abstentions count in that denominator. You cannot vote for yourself. A tie or no majority eliminates no one.
rulebook.night: The app collects each role's private choices, then resolves blocks, recruitment, healing, Mafia attacks, Sniper shots, Zodiac attacks, revival, investigations, and gun delivery in that order. Players alive at the start of resolution still act even if killed that night. No information about a shot or save is public before dawn.
rulebook.defense: Godfather, Sniper, and Zodiac each start with one vest against ordinary bullets. Healing stops ordinary night bullets before a vest is used. Nostradamus is immune to ordinary bullets. Zodiac and a correct Sixth Sense guess bypass both healing and vests. Revival does not restore spent resources.
rulebook.victory: Citizens win when no Mafia or Zodiac remains. Mafia wins at parity with all other living players, but only after Zodiac is gone. Zodiac wins alive among the last two. Nostradamus's chosen side determines their win but does not change Mafia parity counts. Withdrawn players cannot win. If nobody remains, or 50 nights pass, the result is a draw.
rulebook.moderationTitle: The GM keeps the table moving.
rulebook.moderation: The GM opens and closes votes and advances wake windows. Missing responses require an explicit skip: they become passes or abstentions. The GM cannot secretly change a player's role, result, or vote. A stuck or interrupted match can be cancelled; it does not affect statistics.
rulebook.privacy: Use headphones for private roles and results. A player never receives another hidden role from the server. Mafia teammates are visible only in their wake window. Finished or cancelled match reports reveal roles, votes, and choices to participants—not to outsiders. Avoid screen sharing the GM view.
rulebook.origin: These are Mafia Table's rules, not a claim of official Iranian or Hungarian tournament compatibility. They combine familiar social-deduction mechanics with explicit rules for every listed role. The in-app descriptions are the authority for this version.
